event_name: Time 12:29 2018 ABU DHABI GRAND PRIX 22 - 25 November The Stewards commenced their hearing of the Protest lodged by Haas F1 Team against Racing Point Force India F1 Team Cars 11 & 31 at 1100 hrs today. The hearing has been adjourned until 1540 hrs today to allow for the examination of additional documents submitted in evidence. It will reconvene at that time.
title: Doc 9 2018 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix Stewards Information Haas Protest Rp Fi Cars 11 31
